title: Mbulawa Location, Mqanduli (town only, approx.): wanted murder suspect shot dead by police after chase, 17 Oct

story: Police-involved death. SAPS says Tactical Response Team members following up on a man wanted in connection with a murder case saw him driving a white Toyota bakkie in Mbulawa Location, Mqanduli, on Saturday 17 October (about 14:30, Pondoland Times). Police say he sped off, leading a chase along the R411 towards Coffee Bay, then slowed at Mbulawa and pointed a firearm at the police vehicle, and members fired. He died at the scene; no police member was injured. Police say an unlicensed AK-47 with a filed-off serial number was recovered. Police describe him as a person of interest in other murder cases, including the killing of a police officer at Eziko Tavern, Mqanduli; that is a police allegation, not a charge or a conviction. IPID is to investigate, which police call standard procedure. No ballistic result has been reported. He was not named. This is the police account. No independent account and no IPID finding has been reported; the pin records a reported death, not a finding of wrongdoing by anyone.
